title: Upcoming running events in Kochi
description: Compare upcoming Kochi races by date, distance and venue, with direct links to their event pages.
intro: Compare announced races in Kochi, from family runs to the full marathon. Dates, registration and venue details can change; use each event’s linked source before making plans. We omit event-day times when unconfirmed and do not include unannounced editions.

entries.name: Orange Run 2026
entries.description: Orange Runners & Riders Club lists a half marathon, 10 km and shorter categories. The event page says registration closed on 26 October; check with the organizer before travelling or making registration plans.
entries.details: Cochin Port Trust Stadium, Willingdon Island · 21 km · 10 km · 5 km · 3 km

entries.name: Santa Run Kochi 2026
entries.description: The Rotary Club of Cochin Knights Trust lists 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km categories. The event site identifies Lulu Bolgatty International Convention Centre as the race venue; check the organizer for the race schedule and current registration information.
entries.details: Lulu Bolgatty International Convention Centre · 21.1 km · 10 km · 5 km

entries.name: SBI Kochi Navy Half Marathon 2026
entries.description: Organized by Southern Naval Command, the event offers a half marathon, timed 10 km run and 5 km fun run. The published flag-off times are marked provisional; the organizer says the route map will be released closer to race day.
entries.details: Start: Grand Hyatt Convention Center · Finish: Bolgatty Palace Ground · 21.1 km · 10 km · 5 km

entries.name: Federal Bank Kochi Marathon 2027
entries.description: The fifth edition includes a full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 3 km Green Run. The organizer says the route is not yet finalized; check the venue and route before booking travel.
entries.details: Venue to be announced · 42.195 km · 21.097 km · 10 km · 3 km

entries.name: Nammude Run Kochi 2027
entries.description: TE Sports lists children’s runs, a walkathon and both timed and fun-run options for adults. The available categories include 1 km, 2 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km; verify eligibility and the fee for the specific option you choose.
entries.details: Durbar Hall Ground, Kochi · 1 km · 2 km · 3 km walk · 5 km · 10 km
